messages.content: {"task": "Translate EVERY supplied row into Russian. Return JSON only: {\"rows\":[{\"source_id\":\"exact supplied id\",\"target\":\"complete Russian translation\"}]}. Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Les Misérables", "unit": 90, "heading": "XIX LE CHAMP DE BATAILLE LA NUIT", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr81-u090-r0030", "target": "Честный человек испугался бы. Этот рассмеялся.", "source_sha256": "d13fbc5326113ad72de16aead0712df3d24cd316d6f8534e7146137290d685df", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u090-r0030", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "cf51419f14e5ff5e82cf1ff4ebb1ef4d905f4d3ff727cc3ad35c59f462e6ae2b"}, {"source_id": "fr81-u090-r0031", "target": "— Гляди-ка, — сказал он, — это всего лишь мертвец. Лучше уж призрак, чем жандарм.", "source_sha256": "6ffc68aefed98801c816ca7e2a5437e0640096ad623cfc6c7678915265c2cb7a", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u090-r0031", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "5a6ec479396489f0da408278aa36371f6cad30c2d3a674eb15d69d278ed8c961"}], "source_language": "French", "part": 2, "book": 1, "chapter": 19, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr81-u090-r0032", "tag": "prose", "text": "Cependant la main défaillit et le lâcha. L’effort s’épuise vite dans la tombe.", "sha256": "e312fb93f7d05fad1562d40337eaf0db60e1df37027609a5ea6998f22e4beca9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u090-r0033", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ah çà ! reprit le rôdeur, est-il vivant ce mort ? Voyons donc.", "sha256": "5d83338a0b6552cbba6a0bdde0a63eb8d986cf76fb9bcf8a88c6f68d63dd92bc", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u090-r0034", "tag": "prose", "text": "Il se pencha de nouveau, fouilla le tas, écarta ce qui faisait obstacle, saisit la main, empoigna le bras, dégagea la tête, tira le corps, et quelques instants après il traînait dans l’ombre du chemin creux un homme inanimé, au moins évanoui. C’était un cuirassier, un officier, un officier même d’un certain rang ; une grosse épaulette d’or sortait de dessous la cuirasse ; cet officier n’avait plus de casque. Un furieux coup de sabre balafrait son visage où l’on ne voyait que du sang. Du reste, il ne semblait pas qu’il eût de membre cassé, et par quelque hasard heureux, si ce mot est possible ici, les morts s’étaient arc-boutés au-dessus de lui de façon à le garantir de l’écrasement. Ses yeux étaient fermés.", "sha256": "997971b71d585bc6b727cca77eeed71dee4afb293eae2405a1037b853ec2194a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u090-r0035", "tag": "prose", "text": "Il avait sur sa cuirasse la croix d’argent de la Légion d’honneur.", "sha256": "f66ef85834e970190bf9badb412580fddcf5b7bc714303ad62f9f96be2be0c59", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u090-r0036", "tag": "prose", "text": "Le rôdeur arracha cette croix qui disparut dans un des gouffres qu’il avait sous sa capote.", "sha256": "83ce96a105267236dc3ce2daacd16186340f5864594e8de1ae99acfe13ed481e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u090-r0037", "tag": "prose", "text": "Après quoi, il tâta le gousset de l’officier, y sentit une montre et la prit. Puis il fouilla le gilet, y trouva une bourse et l’empocha.", "sha256": "c2b3d364a3fe1a2017a234e33d63075ec80a4dd826a57ac6b0331827a53e0ba4", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u090-r0038", "tag": "prose", "text": "Comme il en était à cette phase des secours qu’il portait à ce mourant, l’officier ouvrit les yeux.", "sha256": "eabf53701d6fb0e4c7999a12503da861b037eb4c3675fa06643fa8b7e1abc4ef", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u090-r0039", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Merci, dit-il faiblement.", "sha256": "1db4310b3e2c45b883fea616a056ab51c32632f0d2ea80cb2991063f3cc8d684", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u090-r0040", "tag": "prose", "text": "La brusquerie des mouvements de l’homme qui le maniait, la fraîcheur de la nuit, l’air respiré librement, l’avaient tiré de sa léthargie.", "sha256": "f571263f0152f30f0dce3bb9d186b5449b4a7d5a6da633abf56070da3aa3b5e0", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u090-r0041", "tag": "prose", "text": "Le rôdeur ne répondit point. Il leva la tête. On entendait un bruit de pas dans la plaine ; probablement quelque patrouille qui approchait.", "sha256": "17da080652cd2b08852d2066fb13643f8e4a487f54695d3319ca7ed6ba23b72d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u090-r0042", "tag": "prose", "text": "L’officier murmura, car il y avait encore de l’agonie dans sa voix :", "sha256": "e2727e4044c31b1484ff20923481e203be06908f7047f9ca4e05699ed433d73d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u090-r0043", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Qui a gagné la bataille ?", "sha256": "56cf5e613d550311a50fb0281621a62ac2c28173b7eb79a2e39ceadfba0378ae", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u090-r0044", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Les anglais, répondit le rôdeur.", "sha256": "711f96246f0a5fd7c2585d34af58b15e47a42c6d42deca52c385e5199da99e35", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u090-r0045", "tag": "prose", "text": "L’officier reprit :", "sha256": "aca47d1094dd11369f799a1d8363f8a4ca69f51b85be945083e260643ad7ad99", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u090-r0046", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Cherchez dans mes poches. Vous y trouverez une bourse et une montre. Prenez-les.", "sha256": "e7a973a1798e314c7418a945e9ccd897e7bf2361f2207dd306f526530d91c576", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u090-r0047", "tag": "prose", "text": "C’était déjà fait.", "sha256": "f6f65869d478dcd584cfb53863fc4a21d8b2e1f1a7099184e60abdb7692a6c62", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u090-r0048", "tag": "prose", "text": "Le rôdeur exécuta le semblant demandé, et dit :", "sha256": "d5c3e89e9b159d0b9e0727ef86a7e7a4a927268c4d6e930e54b8f3b31f7056aa", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u090-r0049", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Il n’y a rien.", "sha256": "12de3426fb38b7dac7505e677b5b41cc113596cf848824a2c07896c29d9b6b6d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u090-r0050", "tag": "prose", "text": "— On m’a volé, reprit l’officier, j’en suis fâché. C’eût été pour vous.", "sha256": "9ede609034eea72bdbcbd2e66ff8c69a84cc425554ca300d8a64ce0698af57dc", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u090-r0051", "tag": "prose", "text": "Les pas de la patrouille devenaient de plus en plus distincts.", "sha256": "a65de9633d05b45b15fefd063970564652cc93f81f01fbaabc31a4a40f484c83", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u090-r0052", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Voici qu’on vient, dit le rôdeur, faisant le mouvement d’un homme qui s’en va.", "sha256": "2fcf24a33c2f099ca5ba761d169d52a56e320884694b2a66559a3fee0aefa797", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u090-r0053", "tag": "prose", "text": "L’officier, soulevant péniblement le bras, le retint :", "sha256": "be9885160269f740bca53c18deb3cd858bceffea9906d89ca9bb99faface3074", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u090-r0054", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Vous m’avez sauvé la vie. Qui êtes-vous ?", "sha256": "069e41cf13d2c732b932240a3eee87f602488d7d58b21565a0718895c355956b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u090-r0055", "tag": "prose", "text": "Le rôdeur répondit vite et bas :", "sha256": "ae46c93f779beea155eb026e6775f30d05ed85bc3171c5f18e59a027800a7345", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u090-r0056", "tag": "prose", "text": "— J’étais comme vous de l’armée française. Il faut que je vous quitte. Si l’on me prenait, on me fusillerait. Je vous ai sauvé la vie. Tirez-vous d’affaire maintenant.", "sha256": "05dec2c45d4ab03b7bffbd31fe2992d6d51372b933cda83a89d4b92813c22192", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u090-r0057", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Quel est votre grade ?", "sha256": "0a92d5b0194c8fc439b66d5fc1a49cac4558b916c7c185c724f76d1a392cbcea", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u090-r0058", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Sergent.", "sha256": "4473b1d54207815b0faac20fa8e381bf4ba0f96def67217c8e5f8187f04bb492", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u090-r0059", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Comment vous appelez-vous ?", "sha256": "0b927e6f778e8c2c0066c9f3108b3992d7d5a8bb76754f4d172b330984b406de", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u090-r0060", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Thénardier.", "sha256": "29ac1ebab57d2f2e41808f354aaf01abe816402c168aebc5db4ecdb8d90f1e86", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u090-r0061", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je n’oublierai pas ce nom, dit l’officier. Et vous, retenez le mien. Je me nomme Pontmercy.", "sha256": "a07c31c21c4853146b782a369eaae3ae1b51359bb09b48b42756ebd6b7ad163b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
